goal: My goal is to put up a hook in the wall but I'm not sure where to drill and how to do it. I'm using these hooks and I have this stud finder.

steps.title: Identify the wall material at the chosen spot
Set the stud finder to wood/stud mode
Scan slowly sideways with the finder held flat
Locate the stud edges and center, or confirm hollow drywall
Choose hardware for the discovered wall material
Position the hook at the mark

observations.note: Stud finder indicated wood; user checked both edges and marked the center.
